tips.text: Collect the Argon Crystal last and start the build right away; stored crystals decay.
Finish Rubedo and Nano Spores in one Nekros survival session, grab Gallium on Mars, then do Argon in the Void and build.
Expect the last one or two Gallium or Argon to cost the most time; Rubedo and Nano Spores are never the bottleneck.
Players treat the Harpak as low-friction mastery fodder: buy it, build it, rank it.
